meta.title: Activating an event group with zero stages is a safe no-op

words.preconditions: A fresh draft event with one line item and no rounds.
steps: The buyer sends the request that updates (and publishes) the event, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app answers cleanly — accepted or refused — but never with a server error.
